class Solution:
    def generateMatrix(self, n: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        res = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
        dirs = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)]
        r = c = d = 0
        for val in range(1, n * n + 1):
            res[r][c] = val
            dr, dc = dirs[d]
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if not (0 <= nr < n and 0 <= nc < n and res[nr][nc] == 0):
                d = (d + 1) % 4
                dr, dc = dirs[d]
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            r, c = nr, nc
        return res

optimal.idea: Layer-by-layer 4-boundary traversal: fill outer border and contract boundaries inward in O(n^2) time.
steps: int top = 0, bottom = n - 1, left = 0, right = n - 1, val = 1.
While left <= right and top <= bottom:
Fill left to right along top (top++); fill top to bottom along right (right--); fill right to left along bottom (bottom--); fill bottom to top along left (left++).
